n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

N = 505
dp1 = [0] * N
dp2 = [0] * N
dp3 = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
dp4 = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
C = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]

for i in range(N):
    C[i][0] = 1
    C[i][i] = 1
    for j in range(1, i):
        C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j] + C[i-1][j-1]) % mod

dp1[0] = 1
for i in range(1, N):
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        dp1[i] = (dp1[i] + dp1[j-1] * dp1[i - j] % mod * C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod
    dp1[i] = (i + 1) * dp1[i] % mod

    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        temp = (dp1[j - 1] * dp2[i - j] + dp2[j - 1] * dp1[i - j]) % mod
        comb = C[i - 1][j - 1]
        val = (i + 1) * comb % mod * temp % mod
        dp2[i] = (dp2[i] + val) % mod

        term2 = (j * (j - 1) // 2 + (i - j) * (i - j + 1) // 2) % mod
        val2 = comb * dp1[j - 1] % mod * dp1[i - j] % mod * term2 % mod
        dp2[i] = (dp2[i] + val2) % mod

for i in range(1, N):
    for j in range(i):
        val3 = dp3[i - 1][j]
        val4 = dp4[i - 1][j]
        for k in range(1, j + 1):
            temp3 = (dp3[i - k - 1][j - k] * dp1[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod
            temp4 = (dp3[i - k - 1][j - k] * dp2[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod
            temp5 = (dp4[i - k - 1][j - k] * dp1[k] % mod * C[j][k]) % mod

            val3 = (val3 + temp3) % mod
            val4 = (val4 + temp4 + temp5) % mod
        dp3[i][j] = val3
        dp4[i][j] = val4
    dp3[i][i] = dp1[i]
    dp4[i][i] = dp2[i]

print(dp4[n][m])
